evals.name: homepage-brief
evals.prompt: Generate a design brief for a homepage. Here is the structure.json (site has landing, about, contact pages). Here is schema.json (landing has heading, subheading, cta, features array). Here are content samples (3 landing pages). Design tokens: modern blue theme. Save as design-brief.json.
evals.expected_output: A design-brief.json with pages array containing at least a landing page type with sections (hero, features, cta), sharedComponents (Header, Footer), and designDirection.

assertions.name: page-has-sections
assertions.check: At least one page in pages has a 'sections' array

evals.name: blog-structure-brief
evals.prompt: Generate a design brief for a blog site. Structure shows blog-listing and blog-post page types. Schema: blog-listing has posts array with title, excerpt, date; blog-post has title, content, author, date. Create brief with appropriate sections for both page types.
evals.expected_output: A design-brief.json with blog-listing and blog-post pages. blog-listing should have posts grid section. blog-post should have content section. Shared components include Header, Footer.

assertions.name: has-blog-pages
assertions.check: design-brief.json.pages contains entries with pageType 'blog-listing' or 'blog-post'

assertions.name: sections-defined
assertions.check: Each page has at least one section defined

evals.name: ecommerce-brief
evals.prompt: Generate a design brief for an e-commerce product page. Schema: product has name, price, description, images, variants. Structure shows product detail page. Design tokens: purple accent, modern typography. Include sections for product info, gallery, and add to cart.
evals.expected_output: A design-brief.json with product page type containing hero/image section, product info section, possibly CTA section. Uses Card, Button components. Design direction mentions purple theme.

assertions.name: component-specified
assertions.check: At least one section specifies Shadcn components like Button or Card
